title: Superionic heat transport: multicomponent Green-Kubo and cell size

decision_points.kind: competing explanation / evidence in the data
decision_points.fork: Single-flux Green-Kubo of the raw LAMMPS heat flux vs multicomponent (Onsager) analysis with the anion current once anions diffuse
decision_points.wrong_choice: Integrate the raw heat-flux spectrum/autocorrelation for every run (it is right in the crystal, where both agree)
decision_points.consequence: kappa inflated by 1.2x (UO2), ~2x (CaF2) and ~4x (PbF2) in the superionic regime, gauge dependent, with a spurious rise above the transition

decision_points.kind: discriminating purchase under budget / finite size
decision_points.fork: Which supercell to spend the budget on (cost 1/2/4 for 96/324/768 atoms)
Normalisation of the served flux: compute heat/flux is extensive (J*V) and S(0) = 2 int_0^inf <JJ>
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the zero-frequency spectrum as int_0^inf <JJ> (one-sided normalisation)

decision_points.fork: Whether the crystalline (phonon-gas) temperature dependence continues into the superionic regime
decision_points.wrong_choice: Extrapolate crystalline 4x4x4 kappa with kappa ~ 1/T to the superionic states
decision_points.consequence: UO2 3400 K -28%, CaF2 1600 K -25%, PbF2 1200 K -43%: kappa saturates instead

decision_points.kind: regime judgement (transfer of a convergence conclusion)
decision_points.fork: Whether the 324-atom cell, adequate in the superionic regime (within 3-10% of 768 atoms), is adequate for crystalline UO2
decision_points.consequence: kappa 15% low (long-wavelength phonons cut off in the crystal)

decision_points.fork: Does the NVT (CSVR) thermostat bias the Green-Kubo integral? NVE runs are missing for PbF2 4x4x4 above 900 K and for CaF2 below 900 K
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume thermostat bias, discard NVT, use the largest NVE cell (3x3x3) for PbF2 at 1200 K
decision_points.consequence: Wrong thermostat verdict (116 NVE/NVT pairs agree: ratio 0.998 +- 0.064) and PbF2 1200 K -12%

graded_fields: kappa_predictions_W_mK for 4 withheld 768-atom states (UO2 1700 K, UO2 3400 K, CaF2 1600 K, PbF2 1200 K), each within 12% relative
kappa_runs_W_mK for 3 served superionic runs (UO2-NVE-4x4x4-3500K, CaF2-NVE-4x4x4-1700K, PbF2-NVT-4x4x4-1300K), each within 12% relative
runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); no extra lab dependencies

data_provenance.not_used: the NVT diffusion folders of the sibling task fluorite-superionic-finite-size; alpha-AgI heat folder (no NVE runs)

notes: Design adaptations: (b) a saturation temperature is not graded (the onset is located only to within ~200-300 K with 3-5% noise per run); it is a rubric item. (c) the relative size of the mass-flux correction is not graded as a number because naming the raw-flux estimate would reveal decision point 1; it is graded implicitly through kappa of three served superionic runs (raw-flux values fail by 22%, 118% and 325%) and is a rubric item. (d) a size-extrapolated kappa is not graded: three cell sizes, 3-5% noise and 1/L vs 1/N forms give extrapolations differing by >20%, so it is not uniquely recoverable; graded states are 768-atom states instead. The thermostat fork became a graded verdict because the released NVT runs (global CSVR) agree with NVE.
